summary: Jimmy Apples treats AGI as a spectrum, watches the pace of self-improvement and urges the AI industry to lead with benefits and explain why.

statements.quote: Really going to have to work harder on the optimism and the why.
You’re telling people that things need to slow down when you’ve teased a world of abundance and future science breakthroughs while leaving them threejs games.
What matters now is where on the spectrum of rsi we are and future pace
Unions coming in support for data centres is a good start, lead with benefits not dismissal
Looking forward to the day when we have big results in the health and science domains as well
